title: Hacker News but for Independent Blogs
summary: Bubbles.town is a community-driven link aggregator and discussion platform similar to Hacker News, specifically designed for discovering and sharing content from independent blogs rather than mainstream publications. It provides an alternative discovery mechanism for readers seeking authentic, non-corporate voices and gives independent bloggers a platform to gain visibility.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of curated discovery platforms dedicated to independent content creators and readers who want alternatives to mainstream news aggregators.
why_valuable: It democratizes content discovery by giving independent bloggers equal visibility alongside established publications, fostering a community around authentic, personal publishing.
